stakes.body_1: Without structural measurement, the risk of AI taking over core activities remains a blind spot in your acquisition price. Your monthly reporting stays a ritual instead of a management tool. Every deal lesson disappears with the next team change.

stakes.body_3: The Scorecard takes twelve minutes. Inaction costs quarters.
